d: DM-NAX-4ZSA-50 DM NAX® 4+1 Zone Streaming Amplifier

specs.label: Audio input signal types
specs.value: 2 stereo analog (RCA); 2 digital S/PDIF (2 TOSLINK and 2 Coaxial); Up to 5 stereo DM NAX or AES67 audio-over-IP streams; Up to 5 stereo cloud-based media streams from streaming service providers

specs.label: Audio output signal types
specs.value: 4 stereo speaker-level amplified outputs; 1 stereo analog line-level output; Up to 9 stereo DM NAX or AES67 audio-over-IP streams

specs.label: Sampling Rates and Bit Depths
specs.value: Digital Input (Coaxial): Up to 192 kHz, 24‑bit; Digital Input (Optical): Up to 192 kHz, 24‑bit; Media Players: Up to 192 kHz, 24‑bit

specs.label: Output Power
specs.value: 50 W per channel at 4 or 8 Ohms

specs.label: Amplifier Monitoring
specs.value: Over Current, Over/Under Voltage, Over Temperature, DC Offset, Clipping

specs.label: S/N Ratio
specs.value: 110 dB digital in; 108 dB analog in

specs.label: Stereo Separation
specs.value: 95 dB @ 1 kHz, 8 Ohm; 90 dB @ 1 kHz, 4 Ohm

specs.label: Zone Separation
specs.value: 100 dB @ 1 kHz, 8 Ohm; 95 dB @ 1 kHz, 4 Ohm
